title: Exam Paper
description: Schema for a parsed university examination paper, capturing its structure, sections, questions, and extraction metadata.

paper_id.description: Unique identifier for this exam paper.

university.description: Name of the university that conducted the examination.

course.description: Degree programme or course name (e.g. B.Tech CSE, MCA).

subject_code.description: Official subject/paper code as printed on the question paper.

exam_year.description: Calendar year the examination was held.

exam_session.description: Session in which the exam was conducted.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the examination in minutes.

sections.description: Ordered list of sections in the paper.

section_name.description: Name or label of the section (e.g. 'Section A', 'Part I').

instructions.description: Instructions printed at the top of this section.

questions.description: List of question identifiers or inline question objects belonging to this section.

total_questions.description: Total number of questions across all sections.

internal_choices.description: Whether the paper contains internal (OR-type) choices within questions.

source_file.description: Original filename or path of the source document from which this paper was extracted.

extraction_method.description: Method used to extract paper data (e.g. 'manual', 'ocr', 'pdf-parse', 'vision').

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence score of the extraction process.

unreadable_portions.description: Descriptions of portions that could not be reliably extracted.
